description: This file defines the Error class in the Twig templating engine, representing base exceptions related to template loading, syntax errors, and rendering issues. It includes methods for managing error messages, source context, and template debugging information.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base exception class for Twig template errors, providing mechanisms to track template name, line, source code, and error message details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Error object with message, line number, source context, and previous exception.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error occurred.

methods.name: setTemplateLine
methods.description: Sets the line number where the error occurred.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context object if available.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Sets the source context object, updating source code, name, and path.

methods.name: guess
methods.description: Attempts to guess template information such as name and line number.

methods.name: appendMessage
methods.description: Appends additional information to the error message.

methods.name: updateRepr
methods.description: Updates the string representation of the error message based on current properties.

methods.name: guessTemplateInfo
methods.description: Guesses template name, path, and line number from backtrace and template object.
